name_ja: 札幌市民防災センター
address: 札幌市白石区南郷通6丁目北
days_closed: Tue (open if holiday), 3rd Thu, day after a holiday
highlight_en: Hands-on earthquake, smoke evacuation, storm wind, fire extinguisher and first-aid/AED corners, attached to Shiroishi fire station.
notes: Disaster-prevention learning facility run by 札幌市防災協会, attached to 白石消防署. Individuals walk in; groups of 10+ book by phone 011-868-3535 (max 50), no group visits Sat/Sun/holidays, and same-purpose visitors count as one group even if they enter separately (notice 2026-09-30). Visit 1-1.5 h. VR disaster corner suspended since 2026-11-23. Temporary closures for equipment checks. Site lists 'multilingual support' without detail.

name_ja: 日本赤十字社 北海道ブロック血液センター
name_en: Japanese Red Cross Hokkaido Block Blood Center
address: 札幌市西区二十四軒2条1丁目1番20号
highlight_en: Glass-walled visitor zone on floors 2-3 looks into the blood testing lab and blood product manufacturing room.
notes: Unguided individual visits need no booking. Guided group tour: Word form by email/fax/post, tel 011-613-6652, fax 011-613-4131. Price not stated (a blog says free). Japanese only page.

name_en: Sapporo Regional Headquarters, Japan Meteorological Agency
address: 札幌市中央区北2条西18丁目
highlight_en: 40-minute observatory tours on weather, earthquakes, volcanoes, climate change and disaster preparedness.
notes: Form only; no phone or email bookings. Staff confirm by contact. Questions: 011-611-3217. Address from Mapion listing.

name_en: Civil Engineering Research Institute for Cold Region (CERI)
address: 札幌市豊平区平岸1条3丁目1番34号
highlight_en: Tours of cold-region labs including the snow and ice team's visibility-obstruction observation vehicle, a low-temperature lab, river hydraulic model and wave basins.
notes: About 20 min per research team, up to 3 teams per visit. Tel 011-590-4046, email shisetsukengaku@ceri.go.jp. Facility may be unavailable for maintenance.

name_ja: 札幌医科大学附属病院 高度救命救急センター
name_en: Sapporo Medical University Advanced Critical Care and Emergency Center
address: 札幌市中央区南1条西16丁目291番地
highlight_en: Hokkaido's only advanced critical care centre and a core disaster base hospital, active in ECMO, air medical transport and disaster medicine.
notes: proposal: needs agreement. Visits offered to students, residents and doctors (smuqq@sapmed.ac.jp); no public tour. Ask the Dept of Emergency Medicine via tel 011-611-2111 or contact form.

name_ja: 手稲渓仁会病院 救命救急センター（ドクターヘリ基地）
name_en: Teine Keijinkai Hospital Emergency Center (doctor-heli base)
address: 札幌市手稲区前田1条12丁目1-40
highlight_en: First hospital in Hokkaido to run a doctor helicopter; resident visit days include the emergency department and doctor-heli.
notes: proposal: needs agreement. Only recruit/resident visits are published (form). For a group visit ask the hospital, tel 011-681-8111. 'First in Hokkaido' from medicalnote.jp.

name_ja: 札幌市消防学校（救急救命士養成所）
name_en: Sapporo City Fire Academy (Paramedic Training Institute)
address: 札幌市西区八軒10条西13丁目3-1
highlight_en: Trains new Sapporo fire staff and runs a paramedic (emergency life-saving technician) training institute with training facilities.
notes: proposal: needs agreement. No public tour page. A paramedic college group observed recruit training in 2024 (yoshida-iryoshika.jp). Contact 教務課 tel 011-616-2262, fax 011-271-0957.

name_ja: 陸上自衛隊 真駒内駐屯地（史料館・部隊見学）
name_en: JGSDF Camp Makomanai (unit tour and history museum)
price_variants: [{"name": "Plan A 30 min", "price_jpy": 0}, {"name": "Plan B 60 min with museum", "price_jpy": 0}]
booking_deadline: 3 weeks before by phone, then form by post/fax (older source)
highlight_en: Plan A (30 min) covers a camp overview and silo barracks; Plan B (60 min) adds the 3-building history museum and US-era buildings.
notes: Home of the 11th Brigade (disaster dispatch). PR staff escort all visits. Tel 011-581-3191 ext 4405. Hours, fee and lead time from 北海道文化資源DB and blogs; extensions differ between sources.

name_ja: 北海道大学 量子集積エレクトロニクス研究センター
name_en: Hokkaido University Research Center for Integrated Quantum Electronics (RCIQE)
address: 札幌市北区北13条西8丁目
highlight_en: Has one of the largest clean rooms on campus, used for compound semiconductor crystal growth and device research.
notes: proposal: needs agreement. Past 30-min clean room tours for students (10 per session). Tel 011-706-7171, rciqeadmin@rciqe.hokudai.ac.jp. Walk time from search summary.

name_ja: 公立千歳科学技術大学 ARIM・シリコンリサーチセンター
name_en: Chitose Institute of Science and Technology (ARIM-CIST, Silicon Research Center)
highlight_en: Shared research equipment (FE-SEM, TEM, Raman imaging, NMR) toured by Rapidus and IBM Tokyo Research staff; clean room used for joint research with companies.
notes: proposal: needs agreement. Silicon Research Center opened 2024 for semiconductor industry research (Nikkei). Tel 0123-25-1001. Near New Chitose Airport and Rapidus. Car about 7 min from New Chitose Airport, 5 min from JR Minami-Chitose; free shuttle ended 2026-04-01. ARIM (32 shared instruments) hosted IBM Tokyo (2025) and a Rapidus executive (2023). Clean room in the research building used for joint research with companies.

name_en: Rapidus Chitose (IIM-1 and Rapidus Chiplet Solutions)
highlight_en: RCS, Rapidus' back-end R&D base inside Seiko Epson's Chitose plant, made a 600 mm square RDL interposer panel prototype in Dec 2025.
notes: proposal: needs agreement. Long shot: city FAQ says IIM is not open to the public. RCS and analysis centre opened 2026-04-11. Ask via Chitose City semiconductor office or the conference organisers. Fallback: view IIM from New Chitose Airport domestic observation deck (blog).

highlight_en: Epitaxial silicon wafer plant; clean room tours given to student groups through METI Hokkaido's semiconductor talent council (Aug 2024).
notes: proposal: needs agreement. No public tours. Tel 0123-28-1877. Council (hkd.meti.go.jp/hokcm/semiconductor/) also arranged visits to Seiko Epson Chitose, Amkor Japan, DXPS, Torex.

name_ja: 道総研 工業試験場
name_en: Hokkaido Research Organization Industrial Research Institute
address: 札幌市北区北19条西11丁目
highlight_en: Free weekday visits with an institute overview, a facility and equipment tour, and recent research results.
notes: Consult by phone 011-747-2321 or iri-shien2@ml.hro.or.jp, then submit form. No sightseeing visits or travel agency bookings; frame as professional visit. Some areas no photos.

name_ja: 雪印メグミルク 酪農と乳の歴史館
name_en: Snow Brand Megmilk Dairy and Milk History Museum
address: 札幌市東区苗穂町6丁目1番1号
booking_opens: 3 months ahead (1st business day of month)
highlight_en: Free guided tour on Hokkaido dairy history at the Sapporo factory, 60 min or 100 min with course B.
notes: Phone 011-704-2329 only. Arriving 15+ min late cancels. Year-end closure dates not given.

name_ja: サッポロビール北海道工場 サッポロ クラシック☆ツアー
name_en: Sapporo Breweries Hokkaido Brewery: Sapporo Classic Tour
nearest_station: サッポロビール庭園駅
price_variants: [{"name": "Adult, 2 beers", "price_jpy": 1000}, {"name": "Junior high to 19, soft drink", "price_jpy": 500}, {"name": "Elementary and under", "price_jpy": 0}]
cancellation_policy: Online until 15:00 the day before, then by phone
highlight_en: 40-minute brewery course on Sapporo Classic production and contract-grown Kamifurano barley and hops, then a tasting.
notes: About 40 min by JR from Sapporo. Groups of 11+ call first. Under 20 must come with an adult; no tasting for drivers. Year-end closure dates not given.

name_ja: 北海道大学総合博物館
address: 札幌市北区北10条西8丁目
highlight_en: Free three-floor museum on Hokkaido University's history and research; seeing everything takes half a day.
notes: English leaflet only (english_ok means self-guided). Group form to museum-jimu@museum.hokudai.ac.jp, tel 011-706-2658. 13 min walk from JR Sapporo Station.

name_ja: 農研機構 北海道農業研究センター
address: 札幌市豊平区羊ケ丘1番地
highlight_en: National agricultural research centre for Hokkaido; weekday visits by online application.
notes: Bus from Fukuzumi to 月寒東1条19丁目 (5 min) then 15 min walk, or taxi 10 min. No applications from tour operators or overseas travellers; visits may be refused. PR tel 011-857-9260.

highlight_en: Sapporo's newest waste plant runs participatory tours with environmental learning, booked online.
notes: From Makomanai Station take Bankei bus to 駒岡団地 and enter by South Gate. City: groups of 10+ in principle, size negotiable. Alt: Shiroishi plant (steam turbine power), tel 011-876-1710.
